findings.correction: A group of some two hundred fully armed men stood outside. / That night, some two hundred martial artists left the Mount Heng Sword Sect.
findings.current: A group of more than two hundred fully armed men stood outside. / That night, more than two hundred martial artists left the Mount Heng Sword Sect.
findings.defect: 이백여 명 is about two hundred, not more than two hundred. The departing force is counted high twice.
findings.rationale: 여 marks an approximate count. Raising it to ‘more than two hundred’ changes the size of the revenge party, a scene quantity.
findings.source: 철저히 무장한 이백여 명의 무리. / 그날 밤, 이백여 명의 무사가 항산검문을 빠져나왔다.

findings.correction: You’re overlooking one important thing. If I’m innocent, then who actually poisoned Lee Seogeun?
findings.current: You’re overlooking one important thing. If I’m innocent, then who was the mastermind behind Lee Seogeun’s poisoning?
findings.defect: 주범 is the principal culprit who poisoned Lee Seogeun, not a behind-the-scenes mastermind.
findings.rationale: The missing puzzle piece is the perpetrator of the poisoning. Mastermind implies an orchestrator the Korean does not name. The next lines still say 범인, ‘culprit.’
findings.source: 중요한 하나가 빠졌네요. 내가 결백하다면 이소군을 독살한 주범은 누구인가?

findings.correction: He’s a master. No doubt about it. At least Super First Rate, maybe even Peak.
findings.current: He’s a master. No doubt about it. At least First Rate, maybe even Peak.
findings.defect: 초일류 is a higher rung than 일류 (First Rate). The guards’ floor is Super First Rate, not ordinary First Rate.
findings.rationale: The packet binds 일류 to First Rate and 절정 to Peak. 최소 초일류 sets the estimate above First Rate on the way to Peak.
findings.source: 고수야. 틀림없어. 최소 초일류, 어쩌면 절정 고수일지도 모르지.

findings.correction: What the hell would a little shit like you know, butting into your elders’ conversation?
findings.current: What the hell does some young punk know, interrupting his elders’ conversation?
findings.defect: 노무 새끼 is a hard insult. Young punk sanitizes the senior guards’ register.
findings.rationale: Hierarchy and characterization sit in the seniors talking down to the junior. The Korean is crude; the English is milder slang.
findings.source: 어린 노무 새끼가 뭘 안다고 어르신들 얘기하는데 끼어들어?

findings.correction: She had adjusted the negotiations like a fastidious businesswoman, then formed an alliance as if it were the most natural thing in the world.
findings.current: Now that I thought about it, she had never once mentioned Lee Seogeun. She had adjusted the negotiations like a shrewd businesswoman, then formed an alliance as if it were the most natural thing in the world.
findings.defect: 깐깐한 is strict, exacting, fastidious. Shrewd adds cunning the source does not use here.
findings.rationale: This is Taekyung’s read of how she handled the talks: picky and businesslike, not necessarily shrewd.
findings.source: 그녀는 단 한 번도 이소군과 연관된 이야기를 꺼내지 않았다. 깐깐한 사업가처럼 협의를 조정하고 당연하다는 듯 동맹을 맺었다.

findings.correction: If we could prove that all of this was a conspiracy carried out by someone else, we could stop the war.
findings.current: If we could prove that everything had been a conspiracy carried out by someone else, we might be able to stop the war.
findings.defect: 막을 수 있다 is that the war can be stopped. Might weakens the hope that then gets shattered.
findings.rationale: The next beat is that this expectation is smashed. Softening the modal changes how sure that hope is.
findings.source: 이 모든 것이 누군가에 의해 벌어진 음모라는 것을 증명한다면, 전쟁을 막을 수 있다.

findings.correction: To meet you again like this—Yama. Whip. Great Hero!
findings.current: It’s wonderful to see you again, Great Hero Yama. Whip!
findings.defect: The syllable break belongs on 염라편, then 대협. Great Hero Yama. Whip splits the epithet into a false name.
findings.rationale: He is performing the title the guards just supplied, one syllable at a time, then Great Hero. The period after Yama makes it sound like Great Hero Yama.

summary: Mostly faithful, but the departure force is inflated from ‘about two hundred,’ 주범 is recast as a mastermind, 초일류 is flattened to First Rate, and the gate seniors’ insult is softened.
